## Libraries

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(MASS)
library(ISLR2)
library(broom)
```

## Data 
```{r}
mpg
```

```{r}
mpg_lm <- lm(hwy ~ cty, data = mpg)

summary(mpg_lm)
```


```{r}
coef(mpg_lm)
```


```{r}
mpg_lm_intercept <- coef(mpg_lm)[["(Intercept)"]]
mpg_lm_intercept

coef(mpg_lm)[["cty"]]
```

```{r}
confint(mpg_lm)

model_coef <- names(coef(mpg_lm))
model_coef
```


```{r}
augment(mpg_lm)
```

```{r}
glance(mpg_lm)
```

```{r}
tidy(mpg_lm)
```
